name: GPT‑5.5 Instant: smarter, clearer, and more  - OpenAI
snippet: GPT‑5.5 Instant is rolling out starting today to all ChatGPT users, replacing GPT‑5.3 Instant as the default model, and in the API as chat-latest. For paid users, GPT‑5.3 Instant will remain available for three months, accessible through model configuration settings, before being retired.

snippet: May 6, 2026 · 3 min read OpenAI Upgrades ChatGPT Default Model to GPT-5.5 Instant in May 2026 OpenAI has updated ChatGPT's default model to GPT-5.5 Instant for all users as of May 2026.
